+# Taskboard CLI
+
+A dependency-free task manager for Bun. Data is stored in `.taskboard.json` in the current directory, or at the path specified by `TASKBOARD_FILE`.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Ship CLI" --tags work,urgent --due 2026-09-10
+bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag urgent
+bun run src/cli.ts done 1
+bun run src/cli.ts stats
+bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
+```
+
+Each command writes one JSON value to stdout. Errors additionally write a diagnostic to stderr and exit non-zero. Dates use `YYYY-MM-DD`; tags are trimmed, lowercased, and deduplicated.
+
+Run tests with `bun test`.
